Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: HEALTH – COMMUNICABLE DISEASES Suggested Vocabulary: virus, hygiene, bacteria, t
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Speaking Fluency: pronunciation Narrative of about 150 words
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Speaking Fluency: pronunciation Narrative of about 150 words, part of HEALTH – COMMUNICABLE DISEASES Suggested Vocabulary: virus, hygiene, bacteria, t in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to speak accurately and express the right feelings? 2. How can you listen more attentively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. list words with sound /h/ from an oral text,

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
